title: [langgenius/dify] Fix issue #38963: preserve explicit falsy workflow inputs
description:
Fix GitHub issue #38963 in langgenius/dify:
https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/38963

Repo:
https://github.com/langgenius/dify

Target:
Preserve explicit falsy user inputs such as False, 0, and empty strings during single-node execution and debugger input mapping, instead of treating them as missing values. Align the fix with the documented root cause in the issue.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change upstream against langgenius/dify.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #38963.
- Testing notes describing how you validated the fix.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.
